spec: Update the gemini provider in packages/core/lib/llm.mjs to send GEMINI_API_KEY via the x-goog-api-key request header instead of interpolating ?key=${apiKey} into the URL query string, and add unit tests asserting the URL has no key parameter and the x-goog-api-key header carries the key.
title: fix(core): send GEMINI_API_KEY in x-goog-api-key header instead of URL query string (#618)
